description: Ministry of City Planning & Water Supply - Order to acquire the lands in Dehiowita and Ruwanwella D/S Divisions for water supply projects
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition for water supply projects. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired (including location, boundaries, and extent), references to property claimants, and is based on the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act. While it mentions a minister's name and title, the core content focuses on land/property matters rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
